MA (q):

Yt = (1 + theta.B^1 + ... + theta.B^q)et

Yt|F(Yt-1) = et + (theta.B^1 + ... + theta.B^q)et 

Yt|F(Yt-1) = et + FUN(et-1) ~ N(FUN(et-1), sigma2)

```{r}
set.seed(123)
calc_AR = function(Y, params){
  sigma2 = params[1]
  n_params = length(params) - 1
  phis = params[2:(n_params+1)]
  n = length(Y)
  ll = rep(0, n)
  
  for(i in (n_params+1):n){
    fun = (phis * Y[(i - n_params):(i-1)]) |> sum()
    ll[i] = dnorm(Y[i], mean = fun, sd = sqrt(sigma2), log = TRUE)
  }
  resultado = -sum(ll)
  return(resultado)
}

calc_MA = function(Y, params){
  n = length(Y)
  n_params = length(params) - 1
  sigma2 = params[1]
  thetas = params[2:(n_params+1)]
  ll = rep(0, n)
  e = rep(0, n)
  
  for(i in (n_params+1):n){
    fun = (e[(i - n_params):(i-1)] * thetas) |> sum()
    e[i] = Y[i] - fun
    ll[i] = dnorm(Y[i], mean = fun, sd = sqrt(sigma2), log = TRUE)
  }
  resultado = -sum(ll)
  return(resultado)
}

calc_ARMA = function(Y, params, order){
    orderAR = order[1]
    orderMA = order[2]
    sigma2 = params[1]
    phis = params[2:(orderAR + 1)]
    thetas = params[(orderAR + 2):(1+orderAR+orderMA)]
    paramsAR = c(sigma2, phis)
    paramsMA = c(sigma2, thetas)
    ll = calc_AR(Y, paramsAR) + calc_MA(Y, paramsMA)
    return(ll)
}
```

```{r}
MA = function(Y, n_params){
  modelo = optim(par = c(1, rep(0.5/n_params, n_params)), fn = calc_MA, Y = Y, method = "L-BFGS-B", lower = c(0, rep(-1, n_params)),
                 upper = c(Inf, rep(1, n_params)))
  
  resultado = list()
  resultado$sigma2 = modelo$par[1]
  resultado$parametros = modelo$par[2:(n_params+1)] |> rev()
  return(resultado)
}

dados = arima.sim(n = 10000, list(ma = c(0.29, -0.2)), sd = 1)

MA(dados, 2)
```

```{r}
AR = function(Y, n_params){
  modelo = optim(par = c(1, rep(0.5/n_params, n_params)), fn = calc_AR, Y = Y, method = "L-BFGS-B", lower = c(0, rep(-1, n_params)),
                 upper = c(Inf, rep(1, n_params)))
  
  
  resultado = list()
  resultado$sigma2 = modelo$par[1]
  resultado$parametros = modelo$par[2:(n_params+1)] |> rev()
  return(resultado)
}

dados = arima.sim(n = 1000, list(ar = c(0.4, -0.1)), sd = 1)

AR(dados, 2) |> print()
arima(dados, c(2,0,0))
```

```{r}
ARMA = function(Y, order){
  orderAR = order[1]
  orderMA = order[2]
  
  modelo = optim(par = c(1, rep(0.1/orderAR, orderAR), rep(0.1/orderMA, orderMA)), fn = calc_ARMA, Y = Y, order = order,
                 method = "L-BFGS-B", lower = c(0, rep(-1, orderMA+orderAR)),
                 upper = c(Inf, rep(1, orderMA+orderAR)))
  
  resultado = list()
  resultado$sigma2 = modelo$par[1]
  resultado$ar = modelo$par[2:(orderAR + 1)] |> rev()
  resultado$ma = modelo$par[(orderAR + 2):(orderMA + orderAR + 1)] |> rev()
  return(resultado)
}

dados = arima.sim(n = 10000, list(ar = c(-0.2, 0.4), ma = (0.9)))
ARMA(dados, c(2,1)) |> print()
arima(dados, order = c(2,0,1))
```

```{r}
gerar_arma = function(n, params, sigma2 = 1){
  phis = params$ar |> rev()
  thetas = c(1, params$ma) |> rev()
  real_n = n + 5000
  e = rnorm(real_n, mean = 0, sd = sigma2)
  y = rep(0, real_n)
  start = max(length(phis), length(thetas))
  
  lphis = length(phis)
  lthetas = length(thetas)
  
  if(phis |> is.null()){phis = 0}
  if(thetas |> is.null()){thetas = 0}
  
  for(i in (start+1):(real_n)){
    y[i] = y[(i - lphis):(i-1)]%*%phis + e[(i - lthetas + 1):(i)]%*%thetas
  }
  return(y[1000:real_n])
}

dados = gerar_arma(n = 10000, params = list(ar = c(-0.1, 0.4), ma = c(0.2, -0.1)))
plot(as.ts(dados))

arima(dados, order = c(2,0,2))
```
